name: IT & Networking
alt: A network cabinet with patch panel, switches and neatly routed blue and grey cables
lede: Wired and wireless networks that stay up. We design, cable, configure and document, so the next person can find the fault as fast as we can.

name: CCTV & Security
alt: A dome security camera mounted under the eaves of a building at dusk
lede: Cameras placed where they actually see, recorders sized for the days you need, and a phone app that works from anywhere.

name: Starlink & Connectivity
alt: A flat satellite internet panel on a pole against a dusk sky
lede: Internet for the places the cable never reached. We supply, mount, power and set up, then stay on call if anything drops.

name: Managed IT Services
alt: Monitors on desks in an office at dusk beside a server tower
lede: Your IT department without hiring one. Monthly, part-time, or when something breaks, with a support line that is answered.

name: Software & Digital Solutions
alt: A laptop and a phone lit up on a desk
lede: Modern websites and business tools, built, hosted and kept running. Solwezi Connect is our own product, so we use what we sell.

name: IT Training
alt: Young Zambian adults learning at desktop computers in a training room, one pointing at a classmate's screen
lede: Practical skills taught by people who install this equipment for a living. Free basic training for youth, and paid courses for businesses.

name: Government e-Services Help
alt: A laptop open on a government services portal
lede: Help applying for any of the 572 services on the Government of Zambia ZamServices portal: PACRA, ZRA, RTSA, licences, land records. You bring the documents; we handle the portal.
